new_parables.title: The Good Samaritan
new_parables.summary: A traveler shows mercy across boundaries; go and do likewise.
new_parables.reflection: Who is your neighbor that God calls you to love with action?
reflection_prompts: Who is easy to overlook that God is placing on your path this week?
What practical mercy will cost you time or comfort — and will you give it?

new_parables.title: The Prodigal Son
new_parables.summary: The Father runs to welcome the returning son; heaven rejoices over repentance.
new_parables.reflection: Where is the Father inviting you home — or inviting you to celebrate another's return?
reflection_prompts: What keeps you from running home to the Father's embrace?
Who needs your celebration rather than your judgment?

new_parables.title: The Talents
new_parables.summary: Servants entrusted with talents are called to faithful, fruitful investment.
new_parables.reflection: What talent has God entrusted to you that He wants multiplied?
reflection_prompts: What fear tempts you to bury what God gave you to invest?
What faithful small investment can you make this week?

new_parables.title: The Lost Sheep
new_parables.summary: The shepherd leaves the ninety-nine to seek the one; every return brings joy.
new_parables.reflection: Who is the one God is sending you to seek with patient love?
reflection_prompts: Who in your life feels lost and needs to be pursued, not written off?
How does heaven's joy over one reshape your priorities?

new_parables.title: The Leaven
new_parables.summary: A little leaven works through the whole batch; small kingdom influence spreads.
new_parables.reflection: What small faithful influence is God multiplying through you unseen?
reflection_prompts: Where can quiet faithfulness leaven your home, work, or community?
What hidden growth are you trusting God with?

new_parables.title: The Pearl of Great Value
new_parables.summary: The merchant sells all for the pearl of great price; the kingdom is worth everything.
new_parables.reflection: What is God worth to you — what would joyful surrender look like?
reflection_prompts: What competes with Christ for supreme value in your life?
What one thing would show you treasure the kingdom above all?
